independent_comparison_oracle.method: Python IEEE F32 decode and independent numeric ordering with explicit NaN/signed-zero policy, plus signed/unsigned integer comparisons.

coverage_scope: All five LD/ST shapes and every legal repeat x1 through x128, with raw32 and pack16/unpack16.
16x32bx2 halfSplit remains a column offset when packing doubles per-element columns.
F32/S32/U32 reduction over both permitted LD shapes.
Compression x4 through x128, cdata, full/partial metadata words and optional reduction.
32 streaming min/max, abs, NaN-propagation, NaN-preservation, ties and signed-zero combinations.
All five CP shapes; both warp-pair multicast patterns and four-way multicast; local and peer memory.
B4/B6 containers use nonzero padding to prove it is excluded from expanded payload.
Twelve native CP descriptor recipes: no swizzle/32/64/128B swizzle crossed with plain/B4/B6.
CP4 destination base+0/32/64/96 lanes and tail refresh at31/63/95/127.
Both-endpoint SHIFT in all quarters, plus four-quarter SHIFT -> CP4 tail refresh -> LD chain.
RF and memory backpressure, malformed commands, memory error, txn mismatch, subsequent recovery and legacy inline adapter.
limitations: Native SMEM descriptor modes remain subject to shared layout helper and top-level legalizer; this report tests only the stated descriptor recipes.
SHIFT last row is preserved by project policy; published evidence and control interpretation are documented in MOVE_IMPLEMENTATION.md.
Pair allocation atomicity, owner permission, mbarrier RMW and complete MMA integration belong to top-level verification.
Memory errors do not roll back already committed writes.
